summary: JFB Construction Holdings filed an 8-K announcing a proposed business combination with Xtend Reality Expansion Ltd. valued at ~$1.5 billion. The filing provides an update and references a Form S-4 registration statement; it does not specify per-share price, premium, or board recommendation. No advisors named. The acquirer is NewCo; JFB is the issuer/target. The transaction awaits SEC effectiveness of the S-4 and stockholder approval. Watch for S-4 filing details, regulatory review timeline, and potential competing bids. Risk-arb angle includes regulatory clearance and stockholder vote risks.
